name: moh_209_patient_list_template
description: MOH 209 Radiology Register patient list template

columns.column: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t1.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 55 AND (pi.voided IS NULL OR pi.voided = 0) ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(pn.given_name, ''), COALESCE(pn.middle_name, ''), COALESCE(pn.family_name, '')) FROM amrs.person_name pn WHERE pn.person_id = t1.person_id AND (pn.voided IS NULL OR pn.voided = 0) AND pn.preferred = 1 ORDER BY pn.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

columns.column: (SELECT pa.city_village FROM amrs.person_address pa WHERE pa.person_id = t1.person_id ORDER BY pa.preferred DESC, pa.person_address_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pa.value FROM amrs.person_attribute pa WHERE pa.person_id = t1.person_id AND pa.person_attribute_type_id = 10 AND (pa.voided IS NULL OR pa.voided = 0) ORDER BY pa.person_attribute_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT COALESCE(cn.name, CAST(o.value_coded AS CHAR), o.value_text) FROM amrs.obs o LEFT JOIN amrs.concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND cn.voided = 0 WHERE o.encounter_id = et.encounter_id AND o.concept_id = 6749 AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(cvm.name, CAST(ed.diagnosis_coded AS CHAR)) ORDER BY ed.dx_rank SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.encounter_diagnosis ed LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm ON cvm.concept_id = ed.diagnosis_coded WHERE ed.patient_id = t1.person_id AND ed.encounter_id = et.encounter_id AND ed.voided = 0)
